correctness.rationale: The theorem follows from the standard Fibonacci divisibility criterion and p-adic lifting formula. For q != 5, z(q) divides pi(q) and pi(q) divides q^2-1, so the induced affine progression has slope invertible modulo every power of q; one residue class modulo q^s gives the exact density q^{-s}. The totient-witness corollary follows directly from the prime-factor formula for phi.

originality.rationale: The classical rank and lifting laws are not claimed as new. The inspected current primary source arXiv:2604.17847v3 uses the non-Wall-Sun-Sun rank lift inside Lemma 4.3 without a valid universal non-Wall-Sun-Sun hypothesis and does not state the q^a residue-class density formula. Searches over equivalent Fibonacci-Wieferich, Wall-Sun-Sun, rank-of-apparition, Fibonacci-totient and residue-class formulations did not identify the same theorem or correction. Residual risk remains from unindexed contemporaneous work.

value.rationale: The result exactly separates the ordinary and hypothetical Wall-Sun-Sun mechanisms. It strengthens the corrected non-Wall-Sun-Sun external-witness conclusion from infinitude to density at least 1 or 1-1/q, while showing that a Wall-Sun-Sun prime would make q^2 an automatic witness on every z(q)-multiple residue class.
